command:
set -eu
repo=$1; github=$2; base=$3; pr=$4; ticket=$5; head=$6; headref=$7; merge=$8; root=$9
block() ( kind=$1; reason=$2; factory linear state "$ticket" Blocked --add ai:blocked --remove ai:needs-review || true; factory linear comment "$ticket" "$kind after merge $merge: $reason. Branch/worktree preserved; merge barrier remains held." || true; factory notify "$kind $ticket/PR#$pr: $reason" || true; exit 1; )
state=$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$github" --json state,mergeCommit --jq '[.state,.mergeCommit.oid]|@tsv')
[ "$state" = "MERGED	$merge" ] || ( echo "landed PR no longer proves exact merge commit" >&2; exit 1; )
ci_ok=false
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  runs=$(gh api "repos/$github/commits/$merge/check-runs" --jq '[.check_runs[] | [.status,.conclusion]]')
  n=$(printf '%s' "$runs" | jq length)
  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '%s' "$runs" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .[0] == "completed")' >/dev/null; then
    printf '%s' "$runs" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .[1] == "success" or .[1] == "neutral" or .[1] == "skipped")' >/dev/null || block "CI RED" "exact merge-commit develop CI failed"
    ci_ok=true; break
  fi
  sleep 10
done
[ "$ci_ok" = true ] || block "CI RED" "exact merge-commit develop CI did not settle before the bounded deadline"
smoke=$(ROOT=$root REPO=$repo bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const y=Bun.YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.ROOT+"/config/repos.yaml","utf8")); const r=y.repos.find(x=>x.name===process.env.REPO); if(!r)process.exit(2); process.stdout.write(r.smoke_workflow??"")')
if [ -n "$smoke" ]; then
  smoke_ok=false
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do
    sruns=$(gh run list --repo "$github" --workflow "$smoke" --branch "$base" --commit "$merge" --limit 20 --json databaseId,status,conclusion)
    n=$(printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq length)
    if [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .status == "completed")' >/dev/null; then
      printf '%s' "$sruns" | jq -e 'all(.[]; .conclusion == "success" or .conclusion == "neutral" or .conclusion == "skipped")' >/dev/null || block "SMOKE RED" "configured smoke workflow $smoke failed at $merge"
      smoke_ok=true; break
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  [ "$smoke_ok" = true ] || block "SMOKE RED" "configured smoke workflow $smoke did not settle at $merge"
fi
ROOT=$root REPO=$repo TICKET=$ticket bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import childProcess from "node:child_process"; import path from "node:path"; const y=Bun.YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.ROOT+"/config/repos.yaml","utf8")); const r=y.repos.find(x=>x.name===process.env.REPO); if(!r||!r.worktree_down||!r.worktree_root||!r.path)process.exit(2); const p=path.join(r.worktree_root.replace(/^~(?=\/)/,process.env.HOME),process.env.TICKET); const q=fs.existsSync(p)&&childProcess.spawnSync("/bin/bash",[r.worktree_down,process.env.TICKET],Object.fromEntries([["cwd",r.path.replace(/^~(?=\/)/,process.env.HOME)],["stdio","inherit"]])); q&&process.exit(q.status??1)'
ref_error=$(mktemp)
if remote=$(gh api "repos/$github/git/ref/heads/$headref" --jq .object.sha 2>"$ref_error"); then
  [ "$remote" = "$head" ] || ( echo "head branch moved; refusing cleanup" >&2; exit 1; )
  [ "$headref" != "$base" ] && [ "$headref" != main ] && [ "$headref" != master ] || ( echo "protected branch cleanup refused" >&2; exit 1; )
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/$github/git/refs/heads/$headref"
elif rg -q 'HTTP 404' "$ref_error"; then
  : # an exact prior cleanup is idempotent
else
  cat "$ref_error" >&2; exit 1
fi
rm -f "$ref_error"
factory linear state "$ticket" Done --remove ai:needs-review --remove ai:escalated --remove ai:blocked --remove ai:in-progress
REPO=$repo MERGE=$merge ROOT=$root bun -e 'const p=process.env; const id="merge-next:"+p.REPO+":"+p.MERGE; const payload=Object.fromEntries([["repo",p.REPO]]); const event=Object.fromEntries([["schemaVersion","factory.event/v1"],["eventId",id],["type","factory.merge.requested"],["source","chain"],["subject",p.REPO],["occurredAt",new Date().toISOString()],["correlationId",id],["causationId",null],["payload",payload]]); console.log(JSON.stringify(event))' | bun "$root/event-runtime/cli.mjs" inject -
